capabilities: Count characters for the whole note, selection, headings, and paragraphs
Show counts as editor decorations and in the status bar without modifying files
Count in Manuscript, Raw Text, VS Code Compatible, or Kakuyomu modes
End body text at 完 or 了 headings and show the total there
Mark full-width spaces, half-width spaces, and line breaks in the editor
disambiguation: It counts characters, not words, so it does not replace a word-count tool for English text.
extras: Settings, commands, and most of the README are in Japanese; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted Japanese character counts rather than an English-oriented word count, including section-end counts so writers of long chapters do not have to scroll back, and a total at the end of the manuscript for checking submission limits.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count is word-based and unsuited to Japanese manuscripts, which need character counts matching those shown on submission sites like Kakuyomu.
summary: Character-count plugin for Japanese writing that shows counts for the whole note, selection, heading sections, and paragraphs in the status bar and editor.
